summary: Stops the call unless the current user is a Workspace administrator.
description: The assertion form of `isAdmin`, and the one to put at the top of anything destructive. It returns nothing: either the call continues or it does not.

params.message: The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted.

returns: nothing; it either passes or throws.

throws.AuthorizationException: the active user is not an administrator.

examples.title: Guarding an action
